headlines.title: Beckham Brands Log Double-digit Growth in Fiscal 2025
headlines.summary: DRJB Holdings posted record revenue and profit, driven by new global partnerships, while Victoria Beckham Holdings reported its first operating profit.

headlines.title: McDonald’s Pledges $8.5B for Restaurant Upgrades
headlines.summary: McDonald's plans $8.5B of franchisee support through 2036 for restaurant modernization, technology deployment, and operational improvements.

headlines.title: Nike and McDonald's Are the Worst-Performing Dow Stocks This Year. Here's the 1 to Buy in October.
headlines.summary: The brands share a similar association as titans of American export culture, and the two stocks are struggling now.

headlines.title: McDonald’s CEO Warns Elevated Inflation Will Stick Around Just Days After Fed Raises Rates
headlines.summary: McDonald's CEO just told investors to stop expecting a recovery and start treating today's bruising consumer environment as permanent, a stark bet against the Federal Reserve made just days after the central bank raised rates again.

headlines.title: McDonald's makes aggressive $8.5B move after previous effort
headlines.summary: McDonald’s discontinued a similar technology project two years ago.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
